recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-2853 unless a future work-group decision revisits contained-resource serialization more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-2853 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for the Initial Draft/DSTU1 DiagnosticReport context. It requested narrative where extension or contained-resource serialization is described and schema behavior that does not allow extensions on the contained element.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify SVN revision 3027 as the application and state that narrative was added while the schema already did not allow extensions. The imported git commit b943ef0d57fd306f7de05120bcae928dc9841f86 added the contained-element extension prohibition to source/references.html.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes references.html in the Foundation documentation, and source/fhir.ini actively lists DomainResource as resource infrastructure plus DiagnosticReport and Observation as current resources. The current DomainResource StructureDefinition defines DomainResource.contained as a Resource-typed element and has extension/modifierExtension only as sibling DomainResource elements; no DomainResource.contained.extension or DomainResource.contained.modifierExtension element exists. Quoted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later community or work-group record that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already contains the requested narrative and conformance source shape.
